g.text: ASL went from 1,602 to 107,899 college students

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #c3c2b7

g.text: Fall enrollments at US colleges. ASL is now the 3rd most-studied language, after Spanish and French.

g.text: Source: MLA, Enrollments in Languages Other Than English in US Institutions of Higher Education, Fall 2021, table 5. Spanish
